# Combobox

Autocomplete input with a filtered listbox (Base UI Combobox). Supports single and multiple selection with chips. The list needs an aria-label.

## Import

```tsx
import { Combobox, ComboboxChip, ComboboxChips, ComboboxChipsInput, … } from "@cesuain/ui";
// or the per-component entry point
import { Combobox } from "@cesuain/ui/combobox";
```

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `combobox.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
